suites.name: integration
suites.coverage: Production CEF and MCP with synthetic data

results.name: Four separate adapters, three live tabs each
Workspace and result isolation
A pending wait does not block other adapters
Page-only screenshots through real MCP image output
Replaced nodes reject stale references
Overlay hit testing rejects obscured input
Same-origin and cross-origin frames expose usable references
Shadow DOM actionability and semantics
Visual coordinates require a current screenshot
JavaScript dialogs are handled without blocking other tabs
Website JavaScript links and logout confirmations remain usable
Download namespace reports opaque scoped metadata
Idle agent handoff preserves live document, form, selection, scroll, stream and site events
Related popups transfer as one ownership group
Mid-drag handoff waits for release before changing ownership
Four workers behind one adapter, three tabs each
Disconnect/reconnect preserves page and never replays mutations

suites.name: batch-integration
suites.coverage: Production CEF and MCP with synthetic data

results.name: modern: eight ordered actions and exact-request deduplication
Separate calls comparison on the same eight-action plan
Replaced target stops the suffix without retargeting
Covered target stops the suffix without retargeting
Navigation cancels original-document targets
legacy: eight ordered actions and exact-request deduplication
Binary remained unchanged

suites.name: visibility-integration
suites.coverage: Production CEF and MCP with synthetic data

results.name: Rendered viewport evidence excludes all hidden payloads from MCP JSON and text
Brightness hover keeps both rendered controls and their references usable
Visible button text remains actionable despite hostile accessibility labels
Decorative box shadows preserve unrelated rendered control references and queries
Icon-only control uses a semantic fallback without exposing its hidden label
A changed visible label invalidates its reference even when the hidden AX name is unchanged
Shadow and frame boundaries preserve visible controls without hidden text
Hidden parent frames reject stale nested and OOPIF child references before website input
Visible generated content is represented or explicitly marked incomplete
Hidden-only text cannot satisfy observation queries or waits
Visible page instructions remain untrusted content without instruction authority

suites.name: worker-lifecycle-integration
suites.coverage: Production CEF and MCP with synthetic data

results.name: Modern and legacy clients cannot retire each other’s workers
Twenty retired workers preserve one live drafted, selected and scrolled session
Retirement cancels queued input and releases a started finite gesture honestly
Configured global capacity spans clients and retirement frees a slot

suites.name: upload-entry-integration
suites.coverage: Production CEF and MCP with synthetic data

results.name: File discovery retains truncation, later pages and scoped relative-path filters
Visible direct file input transfers only an approved opaque file
Approved file follows trusted custom upload entry
Approved file follows trusted cross-frame upload entry
A brightness-styled hover preserves the approved upload entry
A visible button without a file chooser cannot receive a file
Invalid and cross-workspace grants are denied before entry activation
A changed visible upload entry rejects its stale reference before input
A multiple-file chooser receives only the one approved file
Disabled controls and directory pickers cannot transfer files
A parent entry cannot delegate its file grant to a different frame

suites.name: persistence-integration
suites.coverage: Production CEF and MCP with synthetic data

results.name: Distinct workspaces isolate persistent cookies and local storage before restart
Stored state survives a forced process stop and a second launch
A new workspace after restart does not inherit either saved session

suites.name: introduction
suites.coverage: native message driver and fixture-only window captures; no physical input or multi-monitor/DPI acceptance

results.name: Fresh language selection, duplicate-launch gate and cancel/retry
Translated tour, Previous/Next, saved completion and immediate CEF locale
Restart preserves language and opens a blank tab without setup
Menu tour reopens, preserves settings and opens the GitHub URL
Skipping setup saves the selection and starts browsing
First-run documentation link starts Xenon at the requested guide

suites.name: auth-integration
suites.coverage: Unshipped native fixture driver with synthetic data

results.name: Safe page screenshots remain available
No raw eval, CDP, cookies or storage tools
Synthetic password and OTP input events seal all observers through reveal and handoff
Native folder grants persist and upload only approved opaque file handles
Account rights remain per client across handoff
Exact credential origin enforced
GET and readonly forms reject credentials before input or submission
Named login submitter advances the POST flow exactly once
Opaque saved login authenticates without a model-visible credential
Four-agent handoff preserves quarantine and sends no website input
Username-first forms reuse only the exact-origin account

suites.name: human-autofill-integration
suites.coverage: Unshipped native fixture driver with synthetic data

results.name: Automatic native picker appears during cooldown after held input releases
Human autofill fills a CWL-shaped form without submission or agent account grants
Autofilled credentials remain protected from all clients through ownership handoff
Saved accounts cannot autofill a different HTTPS origin
Navigation invalidates an already offered native account selection
Replacing the bound form cannot redirect an existing autofill offer
Dismissing a native offer prevents subsequent filling
Username-first and password-only steps fill only the current phase without advancing
Google-shaped unowned login phases and explicit usernames in richer forms fill only bound credentials
Locking the native vault invalidates pending offers and prevents new autofill
Lock and unlock cannot revive an accepted fill waiting for a finite action to drain

suites.name: workspace-removal-integration
suites.coverage: Unshipped native fixture driver with synthetic data

results.name: Two isolated workspaces have live data, popup, vault grant, approved file and download
Native removal revokes access and pending reads while preserving unrelated live work
Restart purges only the tombstoned profile and cannot recreate its grant
Remaining workspace cookie and local storage survive while shared files remain

results.name: Visible X closes a background tab without selecting its page
Middle click closes the last tab and keeps its workspace
Selecting an empty saved workspace opens a blank human-owned tab
Native Exit persists saved workspaces
Restart retains names and opens only one Personal blank tab
Saved empty workspace remains selectable after restart
Ctrl+W closes the selected tab without deleting its workspace
Final native Exit completes normally

suites.name: native-input-smoke-dialog
suites.coverage: Computer Use synthesized Windows input in the disposable fixture window; not physical-device acceptance

results.name: Windows page input pauses dispatch while retaining creator ownership
Idle resumes authority only with fresh evidence and preserves the human draft
Human dialog holds the pause until dismissal without taking ownership

results.name: First launch opens exactly one human-owned blank tab
Two fixture tabs remain open with persisted state before native Exit
Native whole-application Exit closes the first process successfully
Normal reopen starts blank without loading old tabs or replaying actions
Explicit fixture reopen preserves cookies and local storage
A fresh workspace does not inherit the native workspace session
Closing a workspace only tab preserves its session while the browser stays open

limitations: Synthesized Windows input and native message drivers are distinct from physical input.
High contrast, multi-monitor/DPI, assistive technology and sustained-load acceptance remain unverified.
No real account or production browser profile was used.
Dependencies were not upgraded; this packaging task does not claim current Chromium security parity.
Packages remain unsigned; SHA-256 verifies bytes, not publisher identity.
